editorial.blurb: Bolivar & Lincoln brings authentic Venezuelan flavors to Wrigley in an unassuming, intimate space where generous portions and warm hospitality shine.
editorial.insiderTip: Get a reservation—the space is small and quaint, and you'll want to secure your spot to avoid a wait. Come hungry; portions are hefty.

topDishes.note: chicken, avocado, white cheese, caramelized onions and mushrooms—converts even arepa skeptics
a standout highlight that delivers on flavor
full of flavor and made with care
